questions.question: Sonu was born on June 15, 1992, on what day of the week was he born?
questions.solution:
Given date: 15 June 1992.

 
 

 Year
 Odd Days
 
 

 100
 5 odd days
 
 

 200
 3 odd days
 
 

 300
 1 odd days
 
 

 400
 0 odd days
 
 

Now,

Till 1991 → 1600 + 300 + 91

 
 

 Leap Year
 2 Odd days
 
 

 Ordinary Year
 
 
1 Odd day

 
 
 

 

In 1600 Years the odd day is 0,

In 300 Years the odd day is 1,

In 91 Years(22 Leap Years and 69 Ordinary year) the odd day is 22 × 2 + 69 × 1 = 44 + 69 = 113 odd day ,

⇒ 0 + 1 + 113

⇒ 114 odd days.

And, from 1st Jan 1992 to 15 June 1992:

⇒ 31(Jan) + 29(Feb, 1992 is a leap year) + 31(March) + 30(April) + 31(May) + 15(June) = 167 days.

Total odd days → 114 + 167 = 281days = 281/7 = 40 weeks and 1 odd days.

→ 1 represents Monday.

So, Sonu was born on June 15, 1992 that was **Monday**.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Monday**".

questions.solution:
Given: 8 friends – Jake, Ken, Lily, Dev, Mini, Nancy, Om and Polly are sitting around a square table facing the centre. 

Four of them are sitting at the corners of the table and the other four are sitting in the middle of each of the four sides.

1) Om is sitting second to the right of Jake.

2) Jake is not sitting in the middle of any of the sides.

3) Lily is sitting fourth to the left of Om.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9ea4c4783a9829cccc87546f0c55120357bd05b10a9817085fee474743b60fe.png] 

4) Neither Jake nor Om is an immediate neighbour of Mini.

5) Mini is sitting in the middle of one of the sides.

6) Nancy is not sitting in the middle of any of the sides.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/993be38d091f5475723f544ca97fa6e9a9e4b598e99e925383dd5ffc5cf72627.png] 

7) Polly is not an immediate neighbour of Om.

8) Only one person is sitting between Ken and Mini.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52925c7c53d2d5aec8a61b9cb153f4694c876cf5ade3c29b0fe29a43e10a68cb.png] 

And, Dev will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ed9fc51bf312c4e75b87513131b17fbd4c7451d7aaf765422e3bbd068932050.png] 

So, '**Nancy**' is sitting fourth to the right of Jake.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

S _ _ K B _ F H _ B S F _ K _ S F _ _ B

options.text: F H S K B H H K
F H S H K B H K
F H S K H B H K
F H S K H K H K

questions.solution:

Option 1) F H S K B H H K

S **F** **H** K B / **S** F H **K** B / S F **B** K **H /** S F **H** **K** B → Does not follow pattern.

Option 2) F H S H K B H K

S **F** **H** K B /**S** F H **H** B / S F **K** K **B /** S F **H** **K** B → Does not follow pattern.

**Option 3) F H S K H B H K**

S **F** **H** K B / **S** F H **K** B / S F **H** K **B /** S F **H** **K** B → Follows pattern of **SFHKB** .

Option 4) F H S K H K H K

S **F** **H** K B / **S** F H **K** B / S F **H** K **K /** S F **H** **K** B → Does not follow pattern.

Hence, the correct answer is ***'Option 3'.***

questions.question:
If ‘+’ means ‘−’, ‘−’ means ‘×’, ‘×’ means ‘÷’ and ‘÷’ means ‘+’, what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

62 ÷ 12 × 3 - 8 + 5 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: 62 ÷ 12 × 3 - 8 + 5 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 -
 ×
 ÷
 +
 
 

 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 62 + __**12 ÷ 3**__ × 8 - 5 = ?

⇒ 62 + __**4 × 8**__ - 5 = ?

⇒ __**62 + 32**__ - 5 = ?

⇒ __**94 - 5**__ = 89.

Hence, the correct option is "Option 1".
